commentary_segments.text: Oscillators are required as references of frequency. All clocks are for (micro)processors but all timing circuits also need a clock. The highest precision is obtained by using a crystal as a reference. Without a lot of effort, 0.1% precision is easily achieved. This is why we start this chapter with crystal oscillators. It will be shown that only one single transistor is required to make a crystal oscillator.
